free_tier.stated: Withdrawn. The 2024-02-29 capture states 'NVIDIA LaunchPad provides free access to enterprise NVIDIA hardware and software through an internet browser' and 'Try up to $20,000 (cloud-equivalent) of accelerated compute infrastructure for free'. On 2026-10-22 the URL redirects to build.nvidia.com/explore/discover, an NVIDIA moderator wrote on 2025-11-24 that 'the lab has been discontinued and not just redirect folks over to build.nvidia.com', and the lab host dx.nvidialaunchpad.com now serves 'Your environment is no longer active'.

chaining: Nothing chains now. The successor is build.nvidia.com, whose free tier is a request-rate allowance on hosted inference and carries no accelerator of its own.

notes: This is the refutation exists to record: the largest published number in the accelerator-programme market, USD 20,000 of cloud-equivalent capacity, belonged to a programme NVIDIA has closed. Two candidates were considered before the verdict: (a) the labs moved to a new URL and are still open, refuted by the staff reply naming discontinuation; (b) the page is A/B tested and reachable on another path, refuted because dx.nvidialaunchpad.com itself reports the environment inactive. What would reopen it: a live lab catalog under a new NVIDIA URL with an application form.
